title: Passive voice
intro: The passive lets you focus on what happened rather than who did it. It is everywhere in reports, notices and news. You will also learn how to say that someone did a job for you: have or get something done.
introBn: কে করেছে তার চেয়ে কী হয়েছে বেশি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হলে passive। রিপোর্ট, নোটিশ ও খবরে এটা খুব বেশি ব্যবহার হয়।

units.title: Passive forms: is done, was done, has been done
units.idea: The passive puts the action or result first and the doer second (or nowhere). Form: be + past participle. Change the tense of be, keep the participle.
units.ideaBn: passive-এ কাজটা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ, কে করেছে তা নয়। গঠন: be + past participle। কাল বদলালে শুধু be বদলায়।

formula.name: Present / past
formula.pos: The report is checked daily. · The report was checked yesterday.

formula.name: Perfect
formula.pos: The payment has been made. · The payment had been made.

formula.name: Modal
formula.pos: It must be signed. · It can be done. · It should have been sent.

uses.rule: Use the passive when the doer is unknown or unimportant.
uses.bn: কে করেছে জানা নেই বা দরকার নেই।
uses.ex: My phone was stolen on the bus.

uses.rule: Present simple passive for processes and routines.
uses.ex: All invoices are approved by Finance.

uses.rule: Present perfect passive for news and results.
uses.ex: The new branch has been opened in Uttara.

uses.rule: Modal + be + participle for rules and requests.
uses.ex: This form must be submitted by Friday.

uses.rule: Add by + doer only when it matters.
uses.ex: The design was approved by the client.

traps.right: The office is cleaned every day.
This was done by mistake. / This happened by mistake.
traps.bn: happen, arrive, die-এর passive হয় না।

drills.s: Rafi's laptop ___ from his desk last week.

drills.x: Present perfect passive: has been + V3.

o: The Padma Bridge was opened in 2022.
The Padma Bridge is opened in 2022.
The Padma Bridge was open in 2022.
drills.a: The Padma Bridge was opened in 2022.
drills.x: Past passive with a past date.
Past modal passive: should have been + V3.

units.title: Passive in reports and formal writing
units.idea: Reports, minutes and official emails use the passive to sound objective: 'It was decided...', 'Mistakes were made', 'It is expected that...'. Use it to focus on results and avoid blaming people.
units.ideaBn: রিপোর্ট ও অফিসিয়াল ইমেইলে passive ব্যবহার করলে লেখা নিরপেক্ষ শোনায় এবং কাউকে দোষ দেওয়া হয় না।

formula.name: Impersonal it
formula.pos: It was agreed that... · It is expected that... · It has been reported that...

formula.name: Subject + passive + to
formula.pos: Prices are expected to rise. · He is said to be very strict.

uses.rule: Minutes: It was agreed / decided that...
uses.ex: It was agreed that the launch would move to June.
Sales are expected to grow by 10%.

uses.rule: Polite complaints: focus on the problem, not the person.
uses.ex: The wrong amount was charged to our account.
Staff are requested to wear ID cards.

uses.rule: Results in reports: present perfect passive.
uses.ex: Twenty new clients have been added this quarter.

traps.wrong: It was decided to the meeting that...
traps.right: It was decided at the meeting that...

traps.wrong: Staff are requested wearing ID cards.
traps.right: Staff are requested to wear ID cards.

drills.s: It ___ that the budget would be reviewed in May.
Fuel prices ___ to rise next month.
All staff are ___ (request) to attend the safety training.
Three new branches have ___ (open) this year.

drills.q: Pick the most professional sentence for a complaint.
o: You charged us the wrong amount, you made a big mistake.
We were charged the wrong amount on the last invoice.
We charged the wrong amount on the last invoice.
The wrong amount charged us on the last invoice.
drills.a: We were charged the wrong amount on the last invoice.
drills.x: Passive focuses on the problem politely.

drills.q: জানা গেছে যে নতুন অফিসটা আগামী মাসে খুলবে।
o: It has been reported that the new office will open next month.
It has reported that the new office will open next month.
It is report that the new office will open next month.
It reported that the new office will be open next month by.
drills.a: It has been reported that the new office will open next month.
drills.x: Impersonal passive: it has been reported that.

drills.s: Mr Karim ___ to be very fair with his team.
drills.x: Be said to: people say that he is.

o: The project is expected to finish by December.
The project is expected finishing by December.
The project expects to be finish by December.
The project is expect to finish by December.
drills.a: The project is expected to finish by December.

units.title: Have / get something done
units.idea: Use have or get + object + past participle when someone else does a job for you, usually a service you pay for. Get is a little more informal.
units.ideaBn: অন্য কাউকে দিয়ে কাজ করানো (যেমন চুল কাটানো, গাড়ি সারানো): have/get + object + V3।

formula.name: Have
formula.pos: have + thing + V3: I had my car serviced.

formula.name: Get
formula.pos: get + thing + V3: I need to get my passport renewed.

formula.name: Bad experience
formula.pos: have + thing + V3: He had his wallet stolen.

uses.ex: I'm having my flat painted next week.
Where do you get your hair cut?
We had the AC repaired. (not: we had repaired the AC)

uses.rule: Bad things that happened to you.
uses.ex: Rafi had his phone snatched near Farmgate.
I'll get the documents printed tomorrow.

traps.right: I had my hair cut yesterday.
traps.why: If a barber did it, use have + object + V3.
traps.bn: নিজে না করলে have something done।

traps.wrong: I need to get my passport renew.
traps.right: I need to get my passport renewed.

drills.s: I need to ___ before the trip to Sylhet.
She ___ at a salon in Dhanmondi.
I'm going to get my visa ___ (extend) next week.
We're having the walls ___ (paint) before we move in.

o: I had my phone screen replaced.
I had replaced my phone screen by a shop.
I had my phone screen replace.
I replaced my phone screen at the shop by them.
drills.a: I had my phone screen replaced.

o: I had my laptop repaired yesterday.
I had repaired my laptop yesterday.
I had my laptop repair yesterday.
drills.a: I had my laptop repaired yesterday.
drills.x: A shop did it: had + object + V3.

drills.s: Rafi ___ on the bus to Motijheel.

mastery.s: Your order ___ and will arrive tomorrow.

o: The meeting has postponed until Monday.
The meeting has been postponed until Monday.
The meeting has been postpone until Monday.
The meeting is postponed by until Monday.
mastery.a: The meeting has been postponed until Monday.

mastery.q: আমাকে নতুন প্রজেক্টে যুক্ত করা হয়েছে।
o: I have been added to the new project.
I have added to the new project.
I am add to the new project.
I have been add to the new project.
mastery.a: I have been added to the new project.

o: cut my hair by a barber
The accident was happened at night.
The accident was happen at night.
The accident has happened at night by.

decide.q: Is the doer unknown, obvious or less important than the action?
decide.yes: Use the passive: be + past participle.

decide.q: Did someone else do a service for you?
decide.yes: Use have / get + object + past participle.

decide.q: Does the verb have an object (not happen, arrive, die)?
decide.no: No passive: use the active form.
